name: jsonl_archive_rotate_promotion_lq716_20261108
comment: ANCHOR: JSONL_ARCHIVE_ROTATE_PROMOTION_LQ716_20261108 — LQ-20261107-716: jsonl-archive-rotate left SHADOW for CANARY.
The lane was BROKEN (NOT_IN_LIVE_SET) because its dispatch block said mode dry_run:
n8n_relay_live_lanes.registry_live_lanes short-circuits on dispatch.mode != live BEFORE it reads the stage, so the
lane was silently absent from the rendered N8N_RELAY_LIVE_LANES with an empty excluded map, and the executor clamp
(stage shadow -> dry_run) meant its slot ran --dry-run forever. The gate pins: registry scheduler.stage canary +
dispatch.mode live (class hygiene, retry transient-2); allowlist live_arg [--apply --confirm APPLY] with
output_receipt v2 and the dry_run_arg kept; the lane on the COMPUTED live set with no exclusion entry; the stage
clamp lets a live request through; the health contract moves with the row (stage canary, target_reason stage:canary,
empty_allowed/produced_count); a staged effect key (filesystem, n8n_claim false, executor-inert); and a negative
control that the pre-promotion shadow row is still refused and still silently unexcluded.
Hermetic: reads the repo's config files only; no state root, no DB, no n8n, no live argv.
